Total completed order amount by region (USD): East leads with $86,696, followed closely by South ($86,567), then West ($60,605) and North ($58,331).

| region | total_completed_amount |
|--------|------------------------|
| East   | 86696.0                |
| South  | 86567.0                |
| West   | 60605.0                |
| North  | 58331.0                |

SQL:
```sql
SELECT c.region, SUM(o.amount) AS total_completed_amount
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY total_completed_amount DESC;
```
